name: Acolyte
summary: You devoted yourself to service in a temple.
description: You spent your early years in service to a temple, learning its rites and its lore.

properties.equipment: Calligrapher's Supplies, Book (prayers), Holy Symbol, Parchment (10 sheets), Robe, 8 GP

name: Criminal
summary: You made your living outside the law.
description: You earned your living through crime, and learned to move unseen and to size up a mark.

properties.equipment: 2 Daggers, Thieves' Tools, Crowbar, 2 Pouches, Traveler's Clothes, 16 GP

name: Sage
summary: You spent years learning the lore of the multiverse.
description: You studied under scholars and in libraries, collecting knowledge on a range of subjects.

properties.equipment: Quarterstaff, Calligrapher's Supplies, Book (history), Parchment (8 sheets), Robe, 8 GP

name: Soldier
summary: You trained and served as a fighter in an army or militia.
description: You began training for war young and know the discipline and dangers of the battlefield.

properties.equipment: Spear, Shortbow, 20 Arrows, Gaming Set, Healer's Kit, Quiver, Traveler's Clothes, 14 GP
